name: Default
shortDescription: Free self-hosted Nango for API auth and proxy: dashboard, API, Connect UI and PostgreSQL, with the dashboard behind basic auth.

alerts.message: The dashboard is protected by basic auth: sign in as NANGO_DASHBOARD_USERNAME with the generated NANGO_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD from the environment variables.

Connect UI is served on a second host, connect-<your domain>. When you switch to a custom domain, give Connect UI its own hostname too and update NANGO_SERVER_URL and NANGO_PUBLIC_CONNECT_URL to match.
The free self-hosted edition covers API auth and proxy only; syncs, tool calls, webhooks and MCP need Nango Cloud or an Enterprise plan.
